senses.definition: n.m. grating or lattice-work, cstr. מִכְבַּר;—Ex 27:4 and thou shalt make for it (the alter of burnt-offering in the tab.) מִכְבָּר מַעֲשֵׂה רֶשֶׁת נְחשֶׁת a grating, (even) a network of bronze, which surrounded the lower half of the altar (v 5b): so 38:4; מִכְבַּר הַנְּחשֶׁת 35:16; 38:5, 30; 39:39.
